item.title: IPC Toolkit: collision and friction inside a simulation
item.description: IPC Toolkit is a C++ library for contact calculations. It provides collision detection, distance derivatives and friction potentials. The application supplies the time-stepping loop and solver.

item.title: Thesis submitted at ÉTS
item.description: I submitted my master’s thesis at ÉTS. The work is real-time simulation of surface wear, at the meeting point of physical simulation, contact, and graphics rendering.
